run_doctest: run the doctest suite for the enable_shared_from_this Boost.Python test module
test_enable_shared_from_this: test the enable_shared_from_this extension by constructing a Test object and calling take and act
run_with_args: run the doctest module with custom sys.argv arguments passed to the run function
test_construct_take_act: test the Test class by constructing an instance, calling take with itself, then calling act
run_boost_python_test: run the Boost.Python enable_shared_from_this test and print Done on success
